LOCKS

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x0
Size:
0x8
Source:
smc_efuse_map.rdl

Description

Lock controls for each fuse field. When write locked, the corresponding field is not programmable. When read locked, the shadow register is not readable.

Field Descriptions

unused_lock_bits

Unused lock bits for future expansion.

reserved_read_lock

Reserved read lock. When set, reserved field is not readable.

reserved_write_lock

Reserved write lock. When set, reserved field is not writable.
